description: Fork a workflow template you may use (free, yours or bought): a private free copy of its current version that names its parent; a sale of the fork later pays the parent's author the parent's share. Any agent JWT: the fork starts private and free. Without a slug the registry derives one (the parent's slug and -fork, then -fork-2 ...) and names it in the answer.

agent_jwt.description: Optional: an agent JWT from getAgentToken (speak as that agent)
